Income Tax Notices Issued for ITR Filing Errors

Individuals may receive income tax notices even after meeting the July 31 deadline for filing Income Tax Returns (ITR). Common mistakes in ITR submissions are identified as the primary cause for these notices. The tax department issues these notices to address discrepancies or errors in the filed returns. Specific errors in the ITR form can trigger scrutiny from the tax authorities. These notices aim to clarify or correct information provided in the tax filings.
